text: Visual Studio Code local automations accept five-field cron expressions when preset schedules are not precise enough.
quote: Select Cron to enter a five-field cron expression when the other schedule presets aren't precise enough.

text: Visual Studio Code 1.145 adds cron schedules and workspace custom agents for local automations.
quote: Cron schedules and custom agents for local automations

text: Visual Studio Code cron schedules are not available for cloud automations.
quote: Cron schedules are not available for cloud automations.

text: Each nested Visual Studio Code chat has its own model, agent, and permission levels based on its harness.
quote: Each chat has its own model, agent, and permission levels, based on its harness.

text: An empty enterprise-managed allowlist in Visual Studio Code blocks all servers.
quote: An empty list ( [] ) blocks all servers.

text: Visual Studio Code user and workspace allowlists cannot add servers to the enterprise-managed allowlist.
quote: User and workspace allowlists can't add servers to the enterprise list.

text: Visual Studio Code 1.145 makes enterprise-managed MCP allowlists authoritative over registry-only access.
quote: The enterprise-managed allowedMcpServers list is now authoritative. A server that matches the list can run even if it isn't in the registry, and a registry server that doesn't match is blocked.

text: Visual Studio Code nested sessions can use a different harness than their parent session.
quote: In this release, nested sessions can use different harnesses than their parent session.

text: Local Visual Studio Code automations can use a custom agent from the selected workspace.
quote: Choose a custom agent from the selected workspace when you create or edit a local automation.

text: Visual Studio Code 1.145 includes the preview feature "Mix and match agent harnesses in one session."
quote: Mix and match agent harnesses in one session (Preview)
